title: Rural Broadband Protection Act of 2025

claims.claim: This bill requires the FCC to set up a vetting process

claims.note: 'promise' glosses 'as pledged by the applicant.'

One MATERIAL flag: likelihoodReason asserts a companion 'Rural Broadband Protection Act, S-98' has already been enacted - an extrinsic legislative-status claim absent from the bill source and internally suspect (this bill was placed on the Senate calendar 2025-04-29). Minor items: summary's 'rural and hard-to-serve areas' geographic gloss; sections[1] detail narrows source's 'government' broadband programs to 'federal'; likelihoodReason 'bipartisan support' breadth claim; two minor omissions (reverse competitive bidding inclusion; technology-neutrality principle).
